stem: Which statement describes one action Alabama Governor George Wallace took to maintain the status quo in the 1960s?

options.label: A
options.text: He introduced poll taxes to prevent African Americans from voting in Alabama.

options.label: B
options.text: He blocked African Americans from entering the University of Alabama.

options.label: C
options.text: He ended the use of Jim Crow laws in Alabama.

options.label: D
options.text: He supported affirmative action policies for African Americans in Alabama.
